elemental_attunement.description: Attacking an enemy on an elemental surface grants PIERCE.
elemental_attunement.upgraded_description: Apply BURN X or BLEED X, where X is MAG.

elemental_harmony.description: Gain ATK +1 per adjacent elemental tile.
elemental_harmony.upgraded_description: Gain ATK +2 per adjacent elemental tile.

elemental_shield.description: Creating terrain grants +1 DEF for the turn.

evasive_acrobat.description: Gain GHOST. Moving through enemy tiles applies CONFUSION.

flowing_ki.description: Moving through or jumping over an enemy grants +1 MAG this turn.

inner_peace.description: Spending 0 MOV grants PIERCE on attacks this turn.

light_step.description: Ignore difficult terrain and traps. Ending on a trap disarms it.
light_step.upgraded_description: Ending on a trap grants SHIELD 1.

mind_over_matter.description: Physical attacks scale from the higher of STR or MAG.
mind_over_matter.upgraded_description: Gain +1 DEF if STR equals MAG.

momentum_transfer.description: Gain +1 STR for every 2 tiles moved before attacking.

perfect_form.description: Taking 0 damage last turn grants +1 STR and +1 MOV.

vaulting_strike.description: Vaulting over an enemy grants ATK +2 against that enemy this turn.

weavers_resonance.description: Consuming a Weave stack triggers a 1-tile elemental shockwave and grants SHIELD 1.

zen_defense.description: Gain +1 MAG per empty adjacent tile. If all four are empty, gain SHIELD 1.

rogue_blindside.upgrade_description: If target is STAGGERED, gain ATK +2.

rogue_death_mark.upgrade_description: On Kill, refresh Death Mark for 0 AP.

rogue_grappling_hook.upgrade_description: Target trap collision damage is doubled.

rogue_kidnap.upgrade_description: Target collision applies STAGGER to both.

rogue_shadow_step.upgrade_description: Teleport behind the target; gain +1 STR this turn.

rogue_shadow_swap.upgrade_description: Gain +1 DEF for 1 turn after the swap.

rogue_slip_past.upgrade_description: Move through an adjacent unit to the empty tile directly behind them; upgraded: target DEF -1 for 1 turn.

rogue_switcheroo.upgrade_description: Target inherits incoming attacks aimed at you.

rogue_throat_slit.upgrade_description: On Kill, spread SILENCE to an adjacent enemy.

pass.description: Standard movement has GHOST and passes through enemies, traps, and ZOC.
pass.upgraded_description: Moving directly through an enemy makes the next attack against them ignore DEF.

backstab.description: Attacks originating directly behind an enemy ignore DEF.
backstab.upgraded_description: Also apply BLEED equal to WPN.

blink_mastery.description: After Teleport, the next attack gains ATK +3.
blink_mastery.upgraded_description: The next attack gains ATK +4 instead.

blink_strike.description: Basic attacks can target RANGE 2 and teleport to the target.

board_scrambler.description: After dealing damage, swap the target with the highest-HP enemy in RANGE 3.

debuff_overload.description: Enemies take +1 unmitigated damage per unique debuff at turn start.

killing_intent.description: Ending the turn adjacent to a target below 50% HP grants 1 AP next turn.

lethal_position.description: Gain +1 STR and +1 RANGE per tile moved from the start tile.
lethal_position.upgraded_description: Also gain +1 DEF per tile moved.

miasma_spreader.description: Attacking a debuffed unit spreads its debuffs to adjacent enemies.

mind_static.description: Enemies in RANGE 2 suffer -25% DEF and cannot gain SHIELD.
mind_static.upgraded_description: Range becomes 3 and DEF reduction becomes -50%.

panic_cascade.description: Applying any debuff causes extra damage equal to WPN per active unique debuff this turn.
panic_cascade.upgraded_description: If the target has CONFUSION, extra damage is 2×WPN per unique debuff.

phase_shift.description: Teleporting grants STEALTH until the next attack.
phase_shift.upgraded_description: The first attack out of STEALTH ignores DEF.

shadow_clone.description: On Kill, leave a Decoy on the tile applying TAUNT for 1 turn.
shadow_clone.upgraded_description: The Decoy explodes on death for ATK 2 AOE.

shadow_meld.description: While in SMOKE, skills gain MAG ATK +2 and cost 0 AP once per turn.

shadow_slip.description: Moving directly through an enemy applies BLIND and MARK. Attacking a MARKED target that turn refunds 1 MOV and deals bonus physical damage equal to WPN.

shadow_strike.description: Teleporting adjacent to an enemy applies MARK and ROOT.

shaman_ancestral_spirit.upgrade_description: Target an ally corpse in RANGE 1; summon a Ghost Ally at 25% caster HP for 1 turn.

shaman_bloodlust.upgrade_description: Ally gains STR +2, DEF -2, MOV +1 and spends 2 HP each turn; [+] attacks apply BLEED.

shaman_bone_spear.upgrade_description: SKEWER 4 ATK 2; create a BONE BARRICADE on the furthest empty tile.

shaman_curse_of_weakness.upgrade_description: Target STR -2 and DEF -2 for 3 turns; [+] Push Mitigation = 0.

shaman_earthbind_totem.upgrade_description: Summon a Totem with AOE 2 ROOT pulses; [+] pulses also apply WEAKEN.

shaman_flame_totem.upgrade_description: Summon a Totem with AOE 2 MAG ATK 1 pulses; [+] pulses create FIRE.

shaman_healing_totem.upgrade_description: Summon a Totem with AOE 2 HEAL 1 pulses; [+] pulses CLEANSE.

shaman_hex.upgrade_description: Apply WITHER for 1 turn to a target below Max HP; Boss damage reduction is 25%; [+] VULNERABLE.

shaman_miasma.upgrade_description: MAG ATK 1 and POISON; [+] POISON spreads on PUSH collision.

shaman_pain_spike.upgrade_description: ATK 2; if the target is Linked, deal ATK 1 to linked enemies; [+] linked enemies suffer BLIND.

shaman_soul_siphon.upgrade_description: MAG ATK 1 plus +1 damage per target debuff; [+] HEAL 1 per debuff.

shaman_sympathetic_bond.upgrade_description: Link an ally and enemy; ally HEAL causes enemy WPN damage; [+] enemy damage HEALs ally 1.

shaman_terrify.upgrade_description: Apply FEAR to a debuffed target; Boss fallback strips SHIELD and applies VULNERABLE.

shaman_totem_guard.upgrade_description: Summon a Totem; adjacent allies reduce ranged damage by 2; [+] gain +1 DEF vs melee.

shaman_usher.upgrade_description: Select an ally within RANGE 4; active Totems may also move 2 tiles.

shaman_voodoo_link.upgrade_description: Link 2 enemies; shared damage equals WPN; [+] shared PUSH effects.

hexing_presence.description: Enemies within RANGE 2 suffer -2 STR, -2 MAG, -2 DEF and cannot gain SHIELD.
hexing_presence.upgraded_description: Range becomes 3 and affected enemies also lose -1 MOV.

chain_reaction.description: Applying PUSH to a linked enemy applies PUSH 1 to all linked enemies.

echoing_spirits.description: Totems pulse twice per turn; hazard/debuff damage empowers the next attack with +1 MAG.

hexing_touch.description: Melee attackers suffer permanent STR -1 and DEF -1.

miasma_resonance.description: Enemies in Hexing Presence take +1 damage per BURN, BLEED, or POISON tick and lose -1 MOV.

pain_sharing.description: Linked enemies take +1 damage from all sources.

ritual_sacrifice.description: Once per turn, cast a skill using 3 HP instead of AP.

soul_burn.description: Debuffed enemies take +1 damage and lose -1 MOV.

soul_collector.description: On Kill, drop a Soul Orb: +1 MAG and +1 Max HP, capped at 3 per combat.

soul_weaver.description: Healing a unit removes its oldest debuff and applies it to the nearest enemy.
soul_weaver.upgraded_description: Apply the transferred debuff to the 2 nearest enemies.

spirit_link.description: Linked enemies take WPN unmitigated damage when hit.

spiritual_guardian.description: Totems, Linked Allies, and Ghosts project +1 DEF to adjacent allies.

spiritual_offering.description: Summoning a Totem or using HP for a skill grants SHIELD 1.

sympathetic_magic.description: Linked ally healing also HEALs 1 and grants +1 MAG.

voodoo_conduit.description: Totem, Link, and Debuff maximum range and AOE increase by 1 tile.

voodoo_doll.description: When hit, the closest debuffed enemy suffers WPN unmitigated damage.
